subject: QuantAI — special GPU class & burst-cap exception request (deal desk escalation)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Stern <rachel@quantai.io>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: QuantAI — request: H100 SKU + burst cap / overage cap (SOW attached)

Hi team,

Quick summary: QuantAI needs Dedicated capacity with H100-class GPUs (model inference workload with large key-value cache). They want:
- Reserved pool of 6 H100s for baseline (12m commit)
- Burst allowance up to 18 H100s for short windows (rate-limited burst)
- A hard overage cap of $12k/month beyond committed usage

Why this matters: their latency-sensitive production model has regressed on our recommended A100 config during extended sequences. H100-class shows significant perf gain in our benchmarks (attached). This is a strategic customer (pilot to commercial in Q3) and budget is sensitive — they have requested a 22% discount on committed pricing in exchange for a 12-month reservation.

Attachments: QuantAI_SOW_v2.pdf, GPU_Specs_H100_vs_A100.xlsx

Ask: I need deal-desk approval for:
1) Allow H100 SKU on Dedicated (non-standard)
2) Permit burst to 18 H100s with the proposed overage cap clause
3) Approve the 22% discount on committed monthly fee (with a standard SLA)

Rishi / Ava / Vivek — can you weigh in on the economics, capacity risk, and whether we can accept the overage cap. If needed, I'd like to keep the document-ready addendum so Legal can sign off quickly.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QuantAI_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]
[Attachment: GPU_Specs_H100_vs_A100.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rachel Stern <rachel@quantai.io>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantAI — request: H100 SKU + burst cap / overage cap (SOW attached)

Marissa — thanks for the clear note and the perf docs. High-level thoughts:
- Capacity: we can support H100 variants in Dedicated but it's a constrained SKU in our US region right now; allocating 6 reserved + burst to 18 is doable but will require a temporary reservation hold and possible preemption planning for other customers.
- Economics: at 22% off, unit economics get thin if they frequently exceed committed baseline; the overage cap at $12k/mo is risky unless we tightly define burst window (e.g., 8 hours/day, 5 days/month) and include storage/KV cache pricing.
- Legal/Addendum: we should add explicit language for burst scheduling, peak windows, and an emergency fallback to A100 variants if H100 capacity is unavailable.

Ava — can you run the numbers on marginal cost vs. the proposed cap and confirm worst-case exposure for the year? Vivek — is there any operational flagging we need to add to ensure we can preempt bursts gracefully?

I'll hold until we get finance and infra confirmation before sending QuantAI a firm addendum.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rachel Stern <rachel@quantai.io>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantAI — request: H100 SKU + burst cap / overage cap (SOW attached)

Rishi / team,

I ran a 12-month exposure model with the conservative assumption that QuantAI hits 75% of monthly burst allowance on average. Results:
- Committed revenue (12m): $432k after the 22% discount
- Estimated additional cloud/GPU margin cost from burst (incl. power & infra): ~$140k (12m)
- Net margin after burst: ~18% (below our target for Dedicated deals)
- Worst-case exposure if they consistently max burst: negative by ~$40k/year

Recommendation:
1) Approve H100 on Dedicated but require a slightly higher committed baseline (8 reserved vs 6) to reduce burst frequency.
2) Keep discount at 15% instead of 22% (negotiable to 18% if QuantAI accepts a 24-month commit).
3) If we must keep the $12k overage cap, limit burst to 10 hours/month (per account) and add an automatic throttling clause beyond that.

If Marissa can push the 8-reserve / 15% offer, I think we can green-light with conditional legal language.

—Ava
Ava Chen | Director, Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_Addendum_Overage_Rates.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Stern <rachel@quantai.io>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantAI — request: H100 SKU + burst cap / overage cap (SOW attached)

Thanks — operational notes from infra:
- We can support H100 nodes but will need a reservation hold in our provisioning queue for the 12-month window. That means we may need to defer a small portion of capacity from our unreserved pool; impact minimal if we secure a firm commit.
- We should add measurable SLOs around burst: max concurrent H100s, minimum notice for batch jobs vs interactive jobs, and a graceful fallback to A100 with a short transient latency degradation window.
- Monitoring hooks: we will add an alert to the console for sustained burst > 4 hours and auto-throttle policy after the agreed burst budget is consumed.

Operationally fine with the 8-reserve / capped-burst approach provided Finance amends pricing and Legal signs the addendum.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP, Infrastructure & Product Ops, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Stern <rachel@quantai.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantAI — request: H100 SKU + burst cap / overage cap (SOW attached)

Rachel — thanks for the patience. Internal approvals are in place with the following conditional offer:
1) Reserved baseline: 8 H100s (12-month term)
2) Burst: up to 16 H100s for up to 10 hours/month total; auto-throttle beyond that
3) Discount: 15% off committed Dedicated fees (we can move to 18% for a 24-month commit)
4) Overage: we will remove the hard $12k/month cap; instead we propose a tiered overage schedule (first 50% over baseline billed at 50% discount, beyond that billed at standard overage rates capped at 150% baseline cost) — detailed in the attached addendum.

Next steps: please confirm whether QuantAI accepts the 8-reserve / 15% structure and we will send a DocuSign addendum for signatures. If yes, I will request the provisioning reservation hold immediately.

Best,
—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_Addendum_Overage_Rates.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]
